assets.use: Hero portrait card and horizontal gallery
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original cinematic fantasy architectural photograph, portrait 4:5, ideally 1536 by 1920. A monumental pale limestone stairway and a sequence of very tall slender stone arches bridge two weathered cliffs above a quiet silver-blue sea. A small solitary cypress at the distant landing provides scale; no people. The camera looks along the stairway from a low three-quarter viewpoint, 35mm architectural lens, with precise perspective and immense spatial depth. Early morning sunlight cuts diagonally through the arches; cool maritime haze separates the far cliffs, while warm highlights reveal subtle mineral grain and realistic chisel texture. Palette: chalk, muted teal, smoky blue and a restrained warm sunbeam. The central arches must remain complete within the middle 75 percent of the image, allowing gentle animated parallax and portrait cropping. It should feel like a believable impossible place photographed for a distinguished architecture journal, detailed, atmospheric and quietly spectacular, not a game screenshot. No text, logos, ruins clutter, flying objects, neon or watermarks.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Photograph a completely fictional unbranded premium skincare cream jar as a clean, honest studio product reference. Portrait 4:5, ideally 1536 by 1920. One centered cylindrical jar of soft ivory satin glass with a thin brushed silver screw lid. The jar is short and broad, has a straight cylindrical wall, a lightly rounded bottom edge and a clearly visible lid seam; the lid has a very fine knurled rim. Entirely blank packaging: no label, lettering, symbols or logo. A small soft ivory unbranded packaging carton stands behind and to the right, clearly separated from the jar. Three-quarter eye-level camera, 85mm product lens; include the whole jar and box with generous breathing room. Neutral light-gray tabletop and seamless backdrop, diffused large studio softbox at upper left, realistic soft contact shadows, exceptionally crisp but natural material detail. Jar centered at approximately x=45 percent and y=60 percent; it fills about 38 percent of image width. Minimal, beautiful catalog photography, not deliberately poor or damaged. This image will be the locked reference for a later background and lighting edit, so geometry and materials must be simple, distinct and precise. No other objects, no liquid splash, no human hands, no text or watermark.

assets.use: Hero fashion portrait, fashion landing page and gallery

assets.use: Hero creative still life and gallery

Use case: stylized-concept. An original sophisticated future-architecture artwork with photographic realism, portrait 4:5, ideally 1536 by 1920. Inside an enormous circular conservatory of pale ceramic concrete and brushed aluminum, a single mature olive tree rises from a tranquil reflecting pool. Concentric floating walkways arc around it and lead to a distant opening onto a misty landscape. Believable architectural joints, delicate ribs and curved glass create a powerful sense of scale and spatial depth. Eye-level 28mm architectural view, a carefully framed central tree, complete canopy inside the portrait-safe area, strong foreground, middle ground and background. Elegant near-future environmental design, not cyberpunk, a spaceship corridor or a video game. Clean silhouettes, convincing reflective water, nuanced atmospheric light and meticulous but uncluttered detail. No people, words, logos, colored LEDs, saturated neon or watermarks.

assets.use: Single coherent scroll-story artwork, wide section and gallery
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one exceptional wide cinematic final artwork, landscape 16:9, ideally 2560 by 1440 or higher. A coherent future city floats above an immense ocean of clouds: three connected pale-stone terraced islands with slender towers, lush hanging gardens, narrow sky bridges and reflective pools. The main island sits just right of center; a curving pedestrian causeway enters from the lower left and leads the eye toward the tallest central tower. The overall skyline must be readable and every bridge must visibly connect to an architectural landing. Low warm sunrise from the right side, blue-gray shadows in the cloud valleys, delicate volumetric shafts, realistic subtle atmospheric scattering and a clear distant mountain horizon. Aerial 35mm cinema lens with believable perspective, wide layered composition, extremely fine but orderly architecture, natural small trees rather than random noisy ornament. Silver-white stone, cool mineral teal glass, muted foliage and restrained amber light unify the palette. Reserve the leftmost quarter as quieter cloud space suitable for a separate HTML prompt panel; no baked-in copy. This one finished image will be reused through framing, zoom and masks in a scroll narrative; do not create a storyboard, collage, sketch, intermediate bad result or multiple panels. No text, logos, aerial vehicles, neon or watermark.

Make it feel photographed for a premium fragrance campaign, understated but visually magnetic. No flowers covering the bottle, hands, real trademarks, words, clutter, neon or watermark.
